Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Hands-On Preview: Wuhu Island Is Back, Baby | Comic Con 2026
IGN and Nintendo Voice Chat's Logan Plant went hands-on with Nintendo Switch Sports Resort at San Diego Comic Con, and he's here with Brian Altano to share his impressions. We tried four sports: power cruising, archery, the new thumb wrestling, and the iconic 100-pin bowling, and found that each had us holding the Joy-Con 2 controllers in a different way. Plus, we talk about how it felt returning to Wuhu Island from the 2009 original. Nintendo Switch Sports launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on October 22.

text:
The New Resident Evil Trailer is Perfect, Nails Game Details and Avoids Spoilers | Comic Con 2026
We just got our second trailer for the upcoming live-action Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zack Cregger. There's been a lot of discussion about whether or not this movie will do the source material justice, but the new trailer definitely sells the idea a lot better than the last one: this is a movie based on what it's like to play Resident Evil, but set in the Resident Evil universe. Finding new weapons, scrounging for ammo and supplies, and frantically trying to avoid enemies are all crucial parts of the survival horror experience, and this trailer gives us glimpses of all that without spoiling what happens in the movie. After all, the fun part of a horror movie is not knowing what's lurking behind every corner. Leon Kennedy probably isn't going to show up, but will show us new corners of Raccoon City, new creatures hiding there, and will probably feature a few easter eggs along the way. And hey, ya know what? If it sucks, at least we have Resident Evil Veronica to look forward to, and whatever new games Capcom has in the works after that.

text:
Gundam RG XARX-ZERO - Official Teaser Trailer | Comic Con 2026
Check out the reveal teaser trailer for the new anime, Gundam RG XARX-ZERO, from San Diego Comic Con 2026! 
The RG Project is a new vision for Gundam: A multi-media universe crafted by acclaimed science-fiction filmmaker Kenji Kamiyama (Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex, Star Wars: Visions Volume 3), in which entries share a narrative spanning generations within one continuous world. The initiative brings together the anime Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO and the upcoming, high-mobility action game, GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, each depicting the shared universe from a different perspective.
Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO opens this new saga, set roughly 100 years before the events of GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, telling the beginning of the story and how this world came to be. GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, picks up generations later in a future shaped by accumulated events depicted in the anime. The anime and game come together for an experience that invites Gundam fans to immerse themselves into this new world and make new choices of their own.
